sloka: तथा तयोः संवदतोर्दुर्वासा भगवानृषिः ।रामस्य दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी राजद्वारमुपागमत् ।। ७.१०५.१ ॥
transliteration: tathā tayoḥ saṁvadatordurvāsā bhagavānṛṣiḥ ।rāmasya darśanākāṅkṣī rājadvāramupāgamat ।। 7.105.1 ॥

translations.english: While those two were thus conversing, the revered sage Durvasa, desiring an audience with Rama, approached the royal gate.
